newsitem.title: USA: Lucent unveils Internet telephony system.
newsitem.headline: Lucent unveils Internet telephony system.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc on Monday said it unveiled a new system that allows callers to use ordinary telephones or fax machines to place calls over the Internet.

Lucent said MCI Communications Corp and France Telecom each plans to try out Lucent's platform, called Lucent Internet Telephony Server SP, while GTE Corp's GTE Telephone Operations said it plans to conduct a laboratory evaluation of Lucent's platform beginning this May.
